title: Concept: Predictable generator use (shell) — review required
description: In shell, $RANDOM exposes a predictable generator. Default seeds and observable state make every output guessable, which is fine for sampling but fatal for tokens. The shell-specific remedy is openssl rand.
applicability: shell codebases instantiating or reading the generator; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Guessed security values; LOW default severity because these forms are often test-only, raised when the value guards access.
